Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'

p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/json_generic.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"json","code":"glz::json_t json{};","note":"The fuzzer creates a generic JSON DOM object that will receive attacker-controlled input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzzing/json_generic.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"ec","code":"auto ec = glz::read<opts>(json, buffer);","note":"The raw input bytes are parsed into json_t through Glaze's JSON reader."},
  {"step":3,"file":"include/glaze/json/read.hpp","function":"read","line":44,"var":"value","code":"parse<Opts.format>::template op<is_padded_off<Opts>()>(value, ctx, it, end);","note":"The parser dispatches on the input and recursively builds the JSON DOM from attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"include/glaze/json/json_t.hpp","function":"seek_op<glz::json_t>::op","line":420,"var":"arr[index]","code":"if (index >= arr.size()) return false;","note":"JSON Pointer traversal on arrays computes an index from attacker-controlled pointer text and bounds-checks it before indexing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"include/glaze/json/json_t.hpp","function":"json_t::operator[](std::integral auto&&)","line":122,"var":"std::get<array_t>(data)[index]","code":"json_t& operator[](std::integral auto&& index) { return std::get<array_t>(data)[index]; }","note":"Unchecked vector indexing is the memory-safety sink if a caller reaches array access with an invalid index."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
